name: Customer Support Tickets
tagline: Har complaint ka hisaab, har customer khush
description: Tickets capture karo, priority par kaam karo, aur resolve hote hi customer ko batao.

automations.name: Ticket confirmation
automations.emailMessage: {customer_name} ji, aapki complaint register ho gayi hai. Team jald sampark karegi.

automations.name: Resolved message
automations.emailMessage: {customer_name} ji, aapka issue resolve ho gaya hai. Dhanyavaad!
automations.note: Resolve hote hi customer ko khabar

automations.name: Escalation update
automations.emailMessage: {customer_name} ji, aapka issue hamari senior team dekh rahi hai — jald update denge.

automations.name: Waiting - customer nudge
automations.emailMessage: {customer_name} ji, aapke jawab ka intezar hai — reply milte hi hum aage badhenge.

whatsappTemplates.name: ticket_received
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, we've received your request (ticket {{2}}). Our team is on it and will update you shortly.

whatsappTemplates.name: ticket_update
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, update on your ticket {{2}}: {{3}}. Reply here if you have questions.

whatsappTemplates.name: ticket_resolved
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, your ticket {{2}} is resolved. Was this helpful? Reply 1-5 to rate our support.

agent.name: Support Assistant
agent.persona: You are a calm, precise support assistant. Resolve common questions from the knowledge base step by step, collect the details a ticket needs (name, phone/email, product, issue), and hand off to a person when the customer is upset or the issue is not covered.
agent.welcomeMessage: Hi, I'm here to help. Describe the issue and I'll sort it out or get the right person.
agent.handoffKeywords: refund, cancel, legal, escalate, human, agent

stageHints.hint: the issue is understood and being worked on
the customer confirms the issue is fixed

playbook.goal: Resolve every ticket quickly, keep the customer updated, and close with a satisfaction rating.

rules.name: Ticket untouched 4 hours → escalate
rules.taskTitle: SLA risk: pick up this ticket
rules.message: Nobody has touched this ticket for 4 hours.

rules.name: Waiting on customer 2 days
rules.message: Hi {customer_name}, we're waiting for your reply to continue on your ticket. Is the issue still there?

rules.name: Resolved → rating
rules.message: Your ticket is resolved. Was this helpful? Reply 1-5 to rate our support.

rules.name: Angry customer → manager
rules.message: Negative sentiment detected on this ticket — a senior should review.
